purpose: Teach: オペレーティングシステム/電機/アスキー/スペル/エフェクト/パワーアップ/ポチッ/メッセンジャー
target_vocab: オペレーティングシステム

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: オペレーティングシステムのアップデートを一斉に進めましょう
lines.en: Let's roll out the operating system update across the board.
lines.style: Brisk, clear directive. Clipped pace, efficient tone. No hesitation — leadership voice giving marching orders with confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。電機部品の仕入れ先を見直します
lines.en: Got it. I'll review our electronics suppliers.
lines.style: Steady, competent acknowledgment. Flat-positive tone — not effusive, just confirming readiness. Matter-of-fact delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 文書のアスキー文字部分を確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's verify the ASCII text sections in the documents.
lines.style: Crisp directive, same register as the first. Methodical pacing. Sounds like someone checking items off a list, giving the next instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告スペルチェックの仕組みを整えます
lines.en: Got it. I'll set up the ad spell-check system.
lines.style: Brief, dutiful. Slightly quicker than the previous response — settling into the rhythm of back-and-forth. Professional, no wasted words.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 動画のエフェクト演出を強化しましょう
lines.en: Let's strengthen the visual effects in the video.
lines.style: Same commanding tone. Slightly warmer than the first — she's hit her stride. Still directive, but the rhythm is conversational now.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新サービスのパワーアップ計画を組みます
lines.en: Got it. I'll draft a power-up plan for the new service.
lines.style: Mirrors her energy now. Less formal than his earlier responses — they're in sync. Light, responsive pace.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 発注確定の「ポチッ」と押す仕組みを分かりやすくしましょう
lines.en: Let's make the order confirmation button clearer and easier to use.
lines.style: Still directive, but slightly softer. She's settling into the work — the edge of urgency has smoothed into focus. Clear and measured.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内メッセンジャー利用ガイドを更新します
lines.en: Got it. I'll update the internal messenger user guide.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Warm but professional close. Slight settling-in at the end — the conversation naturally landing.
